name: Music Player
description: Control music from your chat panel. Add a named account, then sign in and start a track in its service window.
skill: Use list_accounts to discover supported services, account IDs and the selected account. For a new account, add_account with a service ID and a label, then open_player. The user signs in and starts the first track in the service window. Select an account with select_account. Read get_playback before play or pause. Only forget_account after the user confirms removing that local login. Never ask for passwords or sign-in codes.
